name: Multi-scale Voxel Hashing
definition: An efficient 3D representation algorithm for mobile AR that converts sparse 3D point clouds from VIO systems into multi-scale voxels using spatial hashing and bottom-up merging to reduce memory footprint and enable collision detection.
summary: Multi-scale Voxel Hashing is a sparse 3D representation using spatial hashing and bottom-up merging to create variable-sized voxels, prioritizing real-time insertion and collision detection over surface reconstruction.
